name: clock-spring-forward
description: Six hours on a 0.85 U/hr profile across a DST change the pump is set for: its clock starts an hour behind the phone's and is set an hour ahead on its screen 180 minutes ago (a TimeChanged record), so it ends on the phone's time. Before it, a 2.0 U pump bolus 240 minutes ago and a 150% temp rate from 200 minutes ago that ends after the change; after it, a 1.0 U pump bolus 90 minutes ago, so the records either side of the change are stamped on different clocks.
